title: Stream start time
hypothesis: With the Hyper-V display disabled, Sunshine's per-session display configuration (ensure_only_display) only adds work: every change makes it re-test all encoders before the first frame. Disabling it (dd_configuration_option = disabled) cuts the time to the first frame.

results.notes: Time from launching Moonlight to its log saying "Video stream is", win10 2026-10-27; ensure_only_display; 60 FPS V-Sync after a 144 FPS run (22.5 s for 60 FPS after 60 FPS)
Time from launching Moonlight to its log saying "Video stream is", win10 2026-10-27; disabled; 60 FPS after 60 FPS
Time from launching Moonlight to its log saying "Video stream is", win10 2026-10-27; disabled; 120 FPS after 60 (9.8 s for 144 after 120, 15.9 s for 60 after the config change)

conclusion: Adopted: connect sets dd_configuration_option = disabled when GpuVM already disabled the Hyper-V display. Opening without changing resolution or FPS goes from 22-27 s to about 2 s; changing the mode still costs 10-15 s because Sunshine sees the display change and re-tests its encoders. Sunshine's log showed 'Encoder reenumeration is required' on every session with ensure_only_display.
